component: QR export browser and policy tests

quotes.text: "The Export for Mobile category should not be present"
"The Export for Mobile pane should not be present"

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The new browser test pushes mail.qrexport.enabled=false and directly checks that the Settings category and pane are absent. Separate policy data cases expect false-policy enabled/unlocked and true-policy disabled/locked through an existing shared runner. These checks are distinct from menu rendering and module-rejection coverage; imported policy-checker assertions and native execution were not inspected or run here.
title: The disabled QR-export browser test checks Settings removal
